name: Sequence patterns
summary: Walk through arrays and strings without starting over at every position.

name: Structure patterns
summary: Keep pending work in the right container, so the next item to handle is always on hand.

name: Tree and graph patterns
summary: Explore connections in an order that guarantees what you find.

name: Optimization patterns
summary: Build the best answer from smaller decisions: take the best step now, or remember answers to smaller problems.
